implementation.sharedUi: Shared React UI consumes the same DashboardClient/DTO for Web, global and session Native views; view state includes scope, epoch and Run identity.
implementation.nativeReader: True Controller managed readonly references; complete native history and incremental source owned by Flow, no Agent resume or execution lifetime ownership.
implementation.settings: Real profile persistence and revisions; own-key inheritance, compare conflicts, requested/effective/application failure/restart feedback.
implementation.protocol: Replay watermark header separates replay from live facts without changing event order; initial/reconnect history remains static.
implementation.packaging: Production ModuleLoader CJS, exactly the allowed nine external module IDs, self-contained Web, shared React 18.3.1 and bundled icon license.
implementation.apiGeneration: Official Typert generator with reproducible --check and explicit --write.
implementation.navigation: One menu registry subscription, finite serialized snapshots, navigation-only registry invalidation and caller/epoch cancellation; no per-Run menu SSE.
implementation.fieldDrafts: Raw local input survives group changes; invalid-only edits keep their base revision and may be discarded. Decimal intermediate text is distinct from serialized numeric operations.
implementation.stopRetries: Known failed stop gets a new operation ID; an uncertain transport outcome replays its original ID, including a failed attempt whose new response was lost.
implementation.protocolCompatibility: Handshake rejects old minor versions lacking mandatory 1.1 features with a terminal incompatible-protocol error; no old-implementation fallback. Future additive minors/unknown fields remain accepted.
